name: Comic Sticker Saga captions
source: Measured 11-26 on 3 hit reels (1.88-1.90 caption changes a second in all three, median caption 0.5 s, mean 1.9 words). Reference drawing: post_fourth_style.py draw_caption(); grouping: style_fourth_style.caption_groups().

fallbacks: Poppins Bold (installed in the cloud sandbox)

position.closeUpRule: When a face fills the frame (close-up, extreme close-up), drop the caption to y 1515 so it never covers eyes or mouth. Measured on 10-20% of captions. cut_plan() framing 'closeup'/'ecu' is the cue.
position.keepClear: Our handle stays top-left (Studio Bible). Captions never go in the top half.

breakRules: before the first word of a new line or sentence
at a pause of 0.15 s or more
at 2 words once the group lasts 0.22 s, or when the next word is a little word (the, of, a, to...)
a single word lasting 0.5 s stands alone
never end a caption on a little word (the, a, of, to, in, my, and...)

timing.showFrom: frame 4-5 of the film (0.13-0.17 s); the voice starts at 0.16 s
timing.onWordStart: a caption appears on the first frame of its first word and stays until the next caption appears (no gaps inside a sentence)
timing.cutRule: cuts land ON a caption start (offset 0): the new shot and the new caption arrive on the same frame
timing.lastCaption: ends with the last word; nothing over the question card except the card itself

animation.out: hard cut to the next caption (no fade)

gold.use: first choice (52% of coloured keywords): treasure, light, names of good things, and ALL spoken dialogue

red.use: second (25%): danger, pain, curses, anything red

magic.use: third: magic words (the account used pink for romance here; we never use romance)

keywordColour.matchTheThing: Colour the keyword to match the object when you can: a red banner gets a red word, a gold coin a yellow one.
keywordColour.dialogue: Spoken lines are shown in quotation marks, all words in gold: "NOT AGAIN!". Narration is white.
keywordColour.markup: In our caption text: {WORD} gold, [WORD] red, <WORD> magic; words inside "quotes" are gold.
keywordColour.perCaption: at most one coloured word per caption, except quoted dialogue

stickers.note: On-screen text that is not a caption. All drawn by post_fourth_style.py; sizes in px at 1080x1920.

nameSticker.fill: the character's own colour (#3FD0C9 teal, #FF5A6E coral, #FFD23F gold, #5EB1D5 sky, #B48CFF lilac)
nameSticker.extras: white swoosh underline, four-point sparkle top-left, shadow 0/6 px 38%
nameSticker.hold: 1-2 shots (1.5-3 s), off on a cut
nameSticker.when: a character's first appearance (2-3 per film)

speechBubble.box: white, rounded (radius 40% of height), 6 px ink outline
speechBubble.tail: points at the speaker's mouth or head
speechBubble.hold: to the end of the shot
speechBubble.when: a quoted line from someone other than the narrator (2-4 per film)

timeTag.icon: hourglass, sun, moon, candle or star at the left
timeTag.position: top-left, x 6-7%, y 15-25% (below our handle; never in the same shot as a name sticker)

kinds: dizzy stars (5, orbiting a knocked-down head, ~1.5 s)
sweat drop beside a nervous face
anger mark beside an angry face

questionCard.dim: background -35% over 8 frames with a soft blur (10 px) and a light vignette
questionCard.premise: Poppins Bold ~40 px, tracked caps, #D8DCE3, top of the block
questionCard.partPill: red #FF4757 rounded pill, white display caps (cap 52 px), 6 px ink
questionCard.question: 2 lines, heavy caps (cap 82 px), white, 7 px ink, key word gold
questionCard.vote: A pill red #FF4757, B pill blue #2F7DF6 (vote episodes only)
questionCard.hold: 4-8 s across 2-4 cuts underneath; ~2 s effects-only tail
questionCard.pop: 4 frames after the dim starts, same 5-frame pop
